gaps.title: Missing dossier signature functionality
gaps.jtbd: When I review a completed dossier as an Epidemiologist, I want to logically sign it, so that my approval is officially recorded on the document.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an Epidemiologist user and a completed dossier report, When they submit a signature request, Then the dossier report is marked as signed and the signature is persisted.
gaps.reason: The brief explicitly requires 'Эпидемиолог с правом подписи досье' (Epidemiologist with the right to sign dossiers), but no signing functionality or state exists in the dossier controllers or entities.

gaps.title: Missing token revocation on logout
gaps.jtbd: When I log out of the system, I want my active authentication tokens to be invalidated, so that my session cannot be hijacked or reused.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an authenticated user with a refresh token, When they call the logout endpoint, Then the token is revoked and subsequent refresh attempts with it fail.
gaps.reason: The brief mandates authenticated sessions via Moodle SSO and fallback auth. A domain-standard expectation for explicit token-based authentication (especially given the existence of a logout endpoint) is actual session termination and token revocation, which is currently a no-op.
